description: Step 6 adapter-isolation baseline. Domain and Application framework/concrete-adapter debt are both zero; any regression is forbidden.

domain_symfony_http.target: 0: HTTP response types belong in adapters.

domain_http.target: 0: Domain cannot depend on HTTP adapters.

application_infrastructure.target: 0: Application depends on ports, never concrete adapters.

application_laravel.target: 0: command/application core should be framework-independent; optimized reads move behind query adapters.

application_http.target: 0: Application cannot depend on HTTP adapters.
